{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data more carefully: check for case sensitivity in 'arm' and 'severity'
print('Unique values in arm (case-sensitive):', trial_df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique values in severity (case-sensitive):', trial_df['severity'].unique())

# Check the full dataframe for rows where severity is 'moderate' and arm is 'control'
print('\nSample of rows with severity == moderate:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate'].head(10))

print('\nSample of rows with arm == control:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control'].head(10))"}
